readiness_trigger.next_action: Retain upstream runtime/E2E/model/instrumentation seals, then resolve the listed retained readiness inputs in the owned queue. No ready comparison remains unrun.

execution_rule.order: Canonical repository order on first repetition, reverse on second, rotate first arm to last on third; same case order and fresh isolated stores
execution_rule.model: Preserve the native account and configured default model/effort; record exact identity in the freeze. No new paid route or model download is authorized by this artifact.
execution_rule.preflight: Retain unsupported role/model interfaces, absent test recipes, failed installations and spending/entitlement constraints with source-backed reasons; never silently omit a survivor. Licence provenance is metadata only, never an exclusion ground.
execution_rule.cost: Record complete provider usage and elapsed time separately from tool-output/token estimates; never infer provider savings
execution_rule.protected_window: Heavy E2E during the CC's Monday window uses systemd-run --user --scope -p CPUWeight=idle; a full suite additionally needs SUITE-REQUEST and SUITE-GO.

fixed_decision_rule.eligibility: For each predeclared role, every mapped role check must pass in all three repetitions with complete usage and upstream E2E at the comparison's immutable source pin. Dependency arms qualify only their mapped interface and are never scored as standalone end-to-end candidates.
fixed_decision_rule.rank: For each role, maximize exact grounded-correct cases, then minimize total provider cost, then median elapsed time, then peak RSS. Compare only arms covering that same role; dependency components keep their own qualification receipts.
fixed_decision_rule.tie: Retain the existing qualified incumbent for that role if tied. Otherwise retain all exactly tied qualified arms with their measured equality; do not claim superiority.
fixed_decision_rule.none_qualify: Record RETIRED for the unsupported role with all failure/retirement reasons; do not promote an unqualified arm.
fixed_decision_rule.terminal: FINAL requires every selected deployed winner's actual final-stack runs[] pin to match its adopted tested source, with verdict/wave/next_review, upstream E2E at that operational run pin and invoke evidence/role reason. An experimental source-pin receipt does not qualify a different historical operational run pin.
fixed_decision_rule.amendments: No new candidates or changed metrics after first run. Any necessary input correction requires a separately reviewed, hashed amendment before affected scoring.

layout_referenced_conversion.reference_definition: Page reference is an explicit native page ordinal normalized to the one-based authored page plus an exact source fragment. Native boxes must enclose authored text/table anchors within fixed two-point edge tolerance. Report page-only, stable-block and geometric scope separately; no page-only geometric superiority or metadata inferred from flat Markdown.

role_reconciliation.qualification_boundary: Role applicability is a preregistered comparison obligation, not a claim that this arm passed the common oracle or supports every required operation.

role_reconciliation.reason: Flat content and native source references have distinct oracles/cases. Poppler still shares flat conversion; MarkItDown uses native Markdown without manufactured metadata. Reference-capable arms retain each native advertised dimension.

retained_comparison_dispositions.frozen_rule_reason: Shared native conversion/OCR/reference cases provide bounded authored-source correctness. They do not imply the retained large olmocr-bench/scanned-set reading-order or table result; seal that native quality recipe before extrapolation.

Native library search/read now compares directly with qmd alongside conversion/OCR/reference checks. The retained judged retrieval and scanned/borderless TEDS study remains a scoring prerequisite; the authored fixture is only a bounded contract.

Common retrieval/absence/source-body checks compare the same normalized corpus, not parser or UI breadth. Resumed maintenance and supported headless install/query are readiness conditions before scoring.

This dependency qualifies native embedding/reranking in the fixed downstream pipeline, not a whole retrieval application. Matched checkpoints and retained judged recall/control panels must be sealed; shapes alone do not prove quality.

Common retrieval against qmd now tests recall/source body/freshness, while versioned-documentation scope remains separate. Website/version gains beyond the authored corpus are retained untested boundaries, not a singleton automatic win.

Common source-grounded retrieval does not assert the retained FinanceBench task ran. Seal its judged financial recipe and supported no-new-paid-key path; a new paid key is a spending/entitlement constraint, never licence exclusion.

Native flat conversion/OCR/structured references meet the shared authored oracle against Poppler and other converters. Scanned/borderless TEDS and throughput remain sealed-input prerequisites; model presence alone is not a result.

Native Markdown/JSON and bounding-box output compare with Poppler on the same authored PDF. The retained heading/table/OCR and borderless-strata quality study is not inferred from a small fixture; retain its recipe before broader claims.
The common rasterization qualifies OCR/source-page boxes, not whole retrieval. Seal the native model and retained OCR quality recipe before extrapolation beyond the authored page.

Its advertised native Markdown output enters content conversion alongside OCR; a model is not a retrieval system. Retained long-document/table quality and supported model settings remain pre-run evidence.

The OCR arm retains a named source-role/recipe gap rather than a universal converter claim. Shared raster/text/table checks govern that scope, and the retained OCR workload requires a supported sealed native recipe.

The missing-vote proposal remains in native conversion/OCR/reference checks. Current maintenance evidence and retained scanned/table recipe gate scoring; neither vote absence nor this bounded fixture decides general merit.
